look_here_first: View flower SIDE-ON: corolla tube (20–)28–41(–45) mm, much longer than A. ciliata at 6–9(–10) mm. Measure the whole tube with a ruler. A frontal flower view cannot establish tube length.

key_traits.label: Habit
key_traits.text: Perennial herb with narrow-leaved stems and tubular flowers.

key_traits.label: Leaves
key_traits.text: Simple narrow stem leaves; examine attachment at node.

key_traits.label: Flowers
key_traits.text: Five corolla lobes above an exceptionally long narrow tube, (20–)28–41(–45) mm.

key_traits.label: Fruit
key_traits.text: Paired slender follicles; obtain a mature fruit view.
